# Storyhold

> Storyhold is a persistent AI roleplaying and worldbuilding platform: create any world, become anyone, and play stories that remember consequential choices.

## Public areas

- Home: /
- Play: /play
- Credits: /credits
- Account and worlds: /profile

World manuscripts, character material, campaign state, private memories, hidden events, and owner tools are not public content and must not be indexed or exposed.
